user.title: Pluggit Avent P
user.description: How is the ventilation unit connected?

relay.title: Relay / contact control
relay.description: Select the two potential-free switches wired to J8. Stage 2 is both off. Never switch both on at the same time.

analog.title: Analog 0-10 V control
analog.description: Select the number entity that outputs the analog voltage on J8-7 (+) / J8-8 (-). 3 V = stage 1, 6 V = stage 2, 9 V = stage 3, 0 V = remote control.

mqtt.title: MQTT / ESPHome gateway
mqtt.description: Topic prefix of the ESPHome firmware. Paste the 32-byte hex frames from the nRF905 sniffer (Letztes Funkpaket / pluggit_avent/rf/rx). Packet 1 = Off, 2 = Stage 1, 3 = Stage 2, 4 = Stage 3.

data_description.rf_packet_1: 32-byte hex from the sniffer, spaces optional. Sent on Off.
data_description.rf_packet_2: 32-byte hex from the sniffer. Sent on Stage 1.
data_description.rf_packet_3: 32-byte hex from the sniffer. Sent on Stage 2.
data_description.rf_packet_4: 32-byte hex from the sniffer. Sent on Stage 3.

error.same_switches: Stage 1 and stage 3 must use different switches.
error.mqtt_not_ready: The MQTT integration is not set up.
error.invalid_rf_packet: Each RF packet must be empty or exactly 32 bytes (64 hex digits).
